properties.description: Contract creation must compute target address before collision checks
properties.formal_spec: FORALL creation: CREATE_OP. check_collision(creation) => computed_address(creation)
properties.rationale: Address must be known to query state for existing code or nonce

properties.description: Collision detected if target address has non-zero nonce OR non-zero code length
properties.formal_spec: FORALL addr: ADDRESS. collision_detected(addr) <=> (nonce(addr) > 0 OR code_length(addr) > 0)
properties.rationale: Either existing transactions (nonce) or existing code indicates collision

properties.description: Empty address (nonce=0, code=0) must allow contract deployment
properties.formal_spec: FORALL addr: ADDRESS. nonce(addr) == 0 AND code_length(addr) == 0 => deployment_allowed(addr)
properties.rationale: Only addresses without history or code are available for deployment

properties.description: Collision detection must consume all remaining gas
properties.formal_spec: FORALL collision: COLLISION. handle(collision) => gas_remaining == 0
properties.rationale: Mimics invalid opcode behavior for deterministic failure

properties.description: Collision must revert all state changes from creation call frame
properties.formal_spec: FORALL collision: COLLISION. handle(collision) => state == state_before_creation
properties.rationale: Atomic failure ensures no partial state modifications persist

properties.description: Failed creation must return zero address to caller
properties.formal_spec: FORALL creation: CREATE_OP. collision_detected(creation) => return_value == 0x0
properties.rationale: Zero address signals creation failure to calling code

properties.description: Deployed contract code must be immutable once deployed
properties.formal_spec: FORALL addr: ADDRESS, t1, t2: TIME. t2 > t1 AND code_at(addr, t1) != empty => code_at(addr, t2) == code_at(addr, t1)
properties.rationale: Core security property - code cannot be replaced after deployment

properties.description: Collision check must execute before init code execution
properties.formal_spec: FORALL creation: CREATE_OP. execute_init_code(creation) => collision_check_passed(creation)
properties.rationale: Prevents any attacker code from running if collision is detected

properties.description: Address with only balance (no nonce, no code) is not a collision
properties.formal_spec: FORALL addr: ADDRESS. balance(addr) > 0 AND nonce(addr) == 0 AND code_length(addr) == 0 => NOT collision_detected(addr)
properties.rationale: Balance alone does not indicate prior contract activity

properties.description: Prague fork rules only apply when fork is active
properties.formal_spec: FORALL block: BLOCK. apply_prague_rules(block) => block.number >= PRAGUE_FORK_BLOCK
properties.rationale: Fork activation is prerequisite for new rules

properties.description: Fork types must be initialized before processing begins
properties.formal_spec: FORALL processing: BLOCK_PROCESSING. fork_active(processing) => types_initialized(processing)
properties.rationale: Prague-specific types required for correct transaction/block handling

properties.description: Transaction must be parsed before validation
properties.formal_spec: FORALL tx: TRANSACTION. validate(tx) => parsed(tx)
properties.rationale: Validation requires internal representation from parsing

properties.description: Failed validation must result in transaction rejection
properties.formal_spec: FORALL tx: TRANSACTION. NOT validation_passed(tx) => rejected(tx)
properties.rationale: Invalid transactions must not be processed further

properties.description: Block header must be validated before transaction processing
properties.formal_spec: FORALL block: BLOCK. process_transactions(block) => header_validated(block)
properties.rationale: Invalid headers indicate malformed or malicious blocks

properties.description: State root must be computed after all transactions processed
properties.formal_spec: FORALL block: BLOCK. state_root_computed(block) => all_transactions_executed(block)
properties.rationale: State root reflects final state after all transaction effects

properties.description: Block finalization requires valid state root computation
properties.formal_spec: FORALL block: BLOCK. finalized(block) => state_root_matches(block.header.state_root, computed_state_root(block))
properties.rationale: State root mismatch indicates invalid block or computation error

properties.description: Attestation must have known slot and epoch before inclusion check
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation: ATTESTATION. check_inclusion(attestation) => known_slot(attestation) AND known_epoch(attestation)
properties.rationale: Slot and epoch required to calculate inclusion window

properties.description: Attestations valid until last slot of epoch N+1 for attestation in epoch N
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation: ATTESTATION. attestation.epoch == N AND current_slot <= last_slot(N+1) => within_inclusion_window(attestation)
properties.rationale: Extended inclusion window allows attestations for full additional epoch

properties.description: Attestations outside inclusion window must be rejected
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation: ATTESTATION. current_slot > last_slot(attestation.epoch + 1) => rejected(attestation)
properties.rationale: Stale attestations provide no security benefit

properties.description: Valid attestations within window must be eligible for block inclusion
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation: ATTESTATION. within_inclusion_window(attestation) AND valid(attestation) => eligible_for_inclusion(attestation)
properties.rationale: Extended window improves attestation availability for proposers

properties.description: Minimum slot requirement must be checked before target epoch check
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation: ATTESTATION. check_target_epoch(attestation) => min_slot_checked(attestation)
properties.rationale: Validation sequence ensures proper ordering of checks

properties.description: Target epoch must be current or previous epoch
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation: ATTESTATION. valid_target_epoch(attestation) => attestation.target_epoch IN {current_epoch, current_epoch - 1}
properties.rationale: Attestations for older epochs are not useful for consensus

properties.description: Invalid target epoch must cause attestation rejection
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation: ATTESTATION. attestation.target_epoch NOT IN {current_epoch, current_epoch - 1} => validation_failed(attestation)
properties.rationale: Attestations for wrong epochs provide no security value

properties.description: TIMELY_TARGET_FLAG always set for valid attestations in extended window
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation: ATTESTATION. valid(attestation) AND included(attestation) => TIMELY_TARGET_FLAG_set(attestation)
properties.rationale: EIP-7045 removes inclusion_delay constraint for target flag

properties.description: Valid attestations within extended window receive non-zero reward
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation: ATTESTATION. valid(attestation) AND included(attestation) => reward(attestation) > 0
properties.rationale: TIMELY_TARGET_FLAG ensures baseline reward for all included attestations

properties.description: Gossip conditions align with extended inclusion window
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation: ATTESTATION. gossip_propagatable(attestation) <=> within_extended_window(attestation)
properties.rationale: Gossip and inclusion windows must be consistent

properties.description: Attestations outside gossip window must be dropped
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation: ATTESTATION. NOT within_extended_window(attestation) => dropped_from_gossip(attestation)
properties.rationale: Prevents network pollution with stale attestations

properties.description: Valid attestations within gossip window must be propagated to peers
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation: ATTESTATION. valid(attestation) AND within_extended_window(attestation) => propagated_to_peers(attestation)
properties.rationale: Ensures attestations reach proposers within extended window

notes: Batch 19 covers three specifications: EIP-684 (contract address collision detection for code immutability), Prague Fork module organization (fork activation and transaction/block processing), and EIP-7045 (extended attestation inclusion window for improved LMD-GHOST security). Critical properties ensure collision detection prevents code replacement attacks, fork activation is checked before new rules apply, and attestation windows are consistently applied across inclusion, validation, rewards, and gossip propagation.
